newsitem.title: UK: Management buys UK's Birthdays Greetings Cards.
newsitem.headline: Management buys UK's Birthdays Greetings Cards.

text.p: Prudential Venture Managers and Schroder Ventures said they had agreed to the purchase of Birthdays Greetings Cards in a management buy out/buy-in worth over 90 million stg.
In a statement, the institutions said they were backing a management team led by John Lovering, former chief operating officer of construction firm Tarmac Plc.
Lovering will become chairman of Birthdays and work with existing management along with an externally appointed commercial director, the statement said.
Ron Wood, founder and current chairman of Birthdays, will leave the board but remain as a consultant to the company.
Birthdays is Britain's largest independent retailer of greetings cards, giftwraps, tags and giftware with over 330 shops and more than 50 franchised outlets.
Operating profits were 11 million stg in the year ending June 1996 on sales of 99.3 million stg.
Prudential and Schroder will provide the whole of the equity requirement while acquisition debt and working capital will be provided by The Royal Bank of Scotland.
"The business has substantial potential. The card and gift market is growing and Birthdays is excellently positioned," Lovering said.
